title: SCORCH vs DEFY
directVerdict: SCORCH is the better fit for thermogenic and cutting, while DEFY is the better fit for energy.
majorFormulaDifferences: Choline Bitartrate: SCORCH 300 mg; DEFY 600 mg.
Caffeine Anhydrous: SCORCH 350 mg; DEFY 300 mg.
Bitter Orange Extract: SCORCH 130 mg; DEFY 120 mg.
Mucuna Pruriens: SCORCH 75 mg; DEFY 50 mg.

Only SCORCH discloses: Potassium Dodecanedioic Acid (Metabolyte): 1100 mg per full serving; Acetyl L-Carnitine HCl: 500 mg per full serving; Dandelion Extract: 500 mg per full serving; Sodium Dodecanedioic Acid (Metabolyte): 400 mg per full serving; Natural Caffeine: 100 mg per full serving; Raspberry Ketone: 250 mg per full serving; Grapefruit Extract: 100 mg per full serving; Evodiamine: 60 mg per full serving.

Only DEFY discloses: Betaine Anhydrous: 5 g per 2 scoops; L-Tyrosine: 1 g per 2 scoops; Alpha GPC: 600 mg per 2 scoops; Dendrobium Extract: 600 mg per 2 scoops; N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine: 500 mg per 2 scoops; Pink Himalayan Salt: 300 mg per 2 scoops; Eria Jarensis: 150 mg per 2 scoops; Cafe Alatus: 100 mg per 2 scoops.
SCORCH caffeine: SCORCH officially lists 450 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (19.2 g). DEFY caffeine: DEFY officially lists 450 mg total caffeine per 2 scoops (27.19 g); 1-scoop option also shown.
experience: SCORCH: SCORCH: A premium, high-caffeine thermogenic pre-workout with substantial disclosed pump support. The easiest concrete points are 450 mg official total caffeine, 8 g L-Citrulline, 20 servings. DEFY: DEFY: A hyper-stimulant pre-workout positioned around intense energy, pump, and performance. The easiest concrete points are 450 mg official total caffeine at two scoops, 10 g L-Citrulline, 5 g Betaine.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers seeking thermogenic positioning with 8 g L-Citrulline
chooseSecondWhen: Customers prioritizing energy and a large disclosed pump formula
tradeoffs: SCORCH: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
DEFY: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A daily low-stimulant request
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: SCORCH for thermogenic and cutting; DEFY for energy.
